description: What ThemeUpgrades answers for each theme or site's settings between bases made from the reference schema, marketplace_website@1.0.0.

cases.name: identity
cases.description: What keeps its path and kind keeps its value: a color, a component property, a footer, a platform's override, a visibility key, an image.

cases.name: moves
cases.description: Moves: a property (and a platform's override of it), a visibility key (and a platform's), a whole page and a key the previous base's own migration moved first (the card's `corner`, its radius since 1.4).

cases.name: moves-to-set
cases.description: A move to a key the theme already sets in the new base's name does not overwrite it; `from` goes either way.

cases.name: map
cases.description: Maps: an option renamed (`underlined` is `always`) and a scale changed (`{size.lg}` is `{space.lg}`), also on a platform; a level the map does not name, and a number, are dropped.

cases.name: map-number
cases.description: A number where a map translates levels is dropped: the map names only what it translates.

cases.name: token-aliases
cases.description: A color moved: its value, its value in dark mode and every alias to it (a property, a border's color, a platform's override) name the new one.

cases.name: type-changed
cases.description: A property whose type changed at the same path (the header's logo width, a level of space in 1, a number in 2) and no move takes: dropped, though 24 would fit both, also on a platform.

cases.name: drop
cases.description: Drops: a visibility key, and a platform's override of it.

cases.name: rewrite
cases.description: The rewrite the base names, passed: the typography `small` becomes `label` and every weight goes up a step.

cases.name: rewrite-skipped
cases.description: The same theme without the rewrite: `small`, which 2 does not name, is dropped, and the weights stay.

cases.name: chain
cases.description: Through 2 to 3: the button's gap is `old_gap` in 1, `icon_gap` in 2 and `icon_space` in 3; the rest of each step as before, the rewrite once.

cases.name: one-schema
cases.description: A chain of one schema: what of the theme fits it.

cases.name: list
cases.description: A list is no theme.

cases.name: settings
cases.description: A site's settings: a setting moved, one dropped, one the new base does not take (an option it has not), and one that stays.

cases.name: settings-chain
cases.description: The same settings through 3.

cases.name: cut-down
cases.description: A theme of 2 for a client of 1: the block's one-to-one maps undone (`always` is `underlined` again, `{space.lg}` is `{size.lg}`, also on a platform where it is a number 1 cannot read); what has the same path and kind and fits 1 stays; a move into a key 1 already has (the gap, `header.search`) is not undone; a property whose type differs and no move takes takes 1's default.

cases.name: cut-down-3
cases.description: A theme of 3 for a client of 2: the gap 3 renamed is `icon_gap` again.

cases.name: cut-down-settings
cases.description: Settings of 2 for a client of 1: a setting 1 has not (its description) is left out; the slug 2 moved into `business_slug`, which 1 has too, stays there.

cases.name: map-boolean
cases.description: A boolean turned around by a map (`true` and `false` as its keys), also a platform's override.

cases.name: map-many
cases.description: A map that merges two options: `neutral` is `soft`.

cases.name: settings-map-boolean
cases.description: A boolean setting that becomes an option by a map.

cases.name: settings-migrate
cases.description: Settings saved with 1.4 read with 1.5, the same base: the setting 1.5 renamed takes its new name.

cases.name: cut-down-renames
cases.description: A theme of 1.5 for a client of 1.4, the same base: every migration 1.4 does not have is undone, a property, a color (its value in dark mode and the aliases to it), a visibility key (and a platform's override) and a home section, in its place.

cases.name: cut-down-chain
cases.description: A theme of 3 for a client of 1: 3's rename undone, then 2's map; the gap is `icon_gap` in both 2 and 1.

cases.name: cut-down-map-boolean
cases.description: A theme of 2 for a client of 1: the boolean the block turned around, turned back, and the map that merged two options, which cannot be undone: 1's default.

cases.name: cut-down-settings-renames
cases.description: Settings of 1.5 for a client of 1.4: the setting 1.5 renamed takes its old name.

cases.name: cut-down-settings-map-boolean
cases.description: Settings of 2 for a client of 1: the option a boolean became is the boolean again.
